entries.title: Make-or-Buy Analysis Reviewer
entries.description: Review make, buy, and hybrid comparisons, evidence gaps, and conditional formal-program duties; draft a decision memorandum when requested.
entries.readme_prompt: Review this make-or-buy worksheet and identify unsupported cost and schedule assumptions.
entries.starter_prompt: Review this fictional make-or-buy decision for 120 test fixtures needed in eight weeks. Make is estimated at $84,000 and ten weeks. Buy is quoted at $79,000 and seven weeks, but the quote excludes integration. The team chose Buy. Identify what supports that choice, what is missing, and whether a hybrid option needs review. Do not draft a decision memo yet.
entries.expected_result: A comparison of the make, buy, and hybrid options that flags evidence gaps and conditional review duties.

entries.title: Individual Subcontracting Plan Reviewer
entries.description: Review individual small business subcontracting plans, goal calculations, methodology, and evidence; draft or revise plan language when requested.
entries.readme_prompt: Check these base and option goals, including overlapping socioeconomic categories.
entries.starter_prompt: Check this fictional individual subcontracting plan worksheet. The base award is $12 million, with $4 million in planned subcontracts. Goals include $1.2 million for small business, $400,000 for women-owned small business, and $300,000 for service-disabled veteran-owned small business; $100,000 falls in both latter categories. Recalculate the percentages and flag gaps in the goal methodology.
entries.expected_result: Recalculated goal percentages, treatment of overlapping categories, and gaps in the goal methodology.

entries.title: Procurement Market Research
entries.description: Find suppliers, public pricing, and evidence for federal prime-contractor market research.
entries.readme_prompt: Research suppliers and public pricing for [product or service].
entries.starter_prompt: For a fictional prime contractor, research U.S. suppliers of handheld barcode scanners that read 1D and 2D codes, work offline, and tolerate warehouse drops. We need 25 within 30 days. Compare public options with source links, listed prices, and any specification or availability gaps. Do not treat list prices as supplier quotes.
entries.expected_result: A sourced supplier comparison with price evidence and limitations.

entries.title: OEM, Publisher & Reseller Research
entries.description: Map documented maker, distributor, reseller, VAR, and other purchasing channels; distinguish verified relationships from potential RFQ contacts.
entries.readme_prompt: Verify whether this reseller is authorized for this product and customer segment.
entries.starter_prompt: For a fictional prime contractor, map public U.S. sales channels for the specific server model I provide. Identify the maker’s direct route, documented distributors, and several potential reseller or VAR RFQ contacts. Separate exact-model listings from broader brand channels, and label current model-specific authorization only when the maker confirms it.
entries.expected_result: A sourced channel map separating verified roles, supplier claims, potential RFQ contacts, and unresolved authorization scope.

entries.title: FAR-Compliant Commercial Item Determination
entries.description: Assess commercial product, service, and COTS status under FAR 2.101.
entries.readme_prompt: Assess whether this software subscription is a commercial product or service.
entries.starter_prompt: Assess this fictional offer under FAR 2.101: ExampleCloud sells a standard hosted scheduling subscription to private businesses at published per-seat rates. Our buyer also wants a custom reporting dashboard. Evaluate commercial product, commercial service, and COTS status separately, and identify evidence needed before a determination.
entries.expected_result: A commerciality analysis organized around the relevant definition and evidence gaps.

entries.title: FAR-Compliant Non-Competitive Source Justification
entries.description: Research suppliers, alternatives, and public prices, then draft a supported sole-source or noncompetitive justification.
entries.readme_prompt: Review this sole-source justification and identify unsupported claims.
entries.starter_prompt: Review a fictional prime contractor’s proposed $48,000 purchase of a replacement control module from the original manufacturer. The requester says it is the only module that fits an installed test stand, but has no market search or compatibility evidence. Draft the four-part noncompetitive justification with clear placeholders for unsupported claims; do not present it as approved.
entries.expected_result: A four-part justification draft or evidence checklist that distinguishes research from assumptions.

entries.title: FAR-Compliant Price Analysis for Goods
entries.description: Draft price analyses for government-funded goods using competition and market evidence.
entries.readme_prompt: Draft a price analysis from these three quotes for the same item.
entries.starter_prompt: For a fictional government-funded fixed-price purchase, compare quotes for 20 monitors of the same model: Alder at $1,120 each with delivery in two weeks, Birch at $1,190 each with delivery in one week, and Cedar at $1,340 each with freight unclear. The program needs them in ten days and proposes Birch. Draft a price justification and flag comparability gaps.
entries.expected_result: A price analysis comparing the quotes and explaining unresolved differences.

entries.title: Commercial and Indirect Price Analysis (Lite)
entries.description: Draft evidence-based price analyses for commercial and indirect purchases.
entries.readme_prompt: Compare these two consulting proposals and explain whether the selected price is reasonable.
entries.starter_prompt: For a fictional internal training purchase, compare an $8,400 proposal for six virtual sessions with a $9,100 proposal for four onsite sessions plus materials. Our team prefers onsite delivery. Draft a short price-reasonableness note that addresses the scope difference and identifies what needs clarification before award. This is a company indirect purchase, not a government subcontract.
entries.expected_result: A concise price comparison that addresses scope differences and evidence gaps.

entries.title: FAR-Compliant Price Analysis for Subcontracts (Lite)
entries.description: Draft subcontract bid summaries and price analyses for awards, options, and modifications.
entries.readme_prompt: Draft a bid summary and price analysis for this subcontract award.
entries.starter_prompt: Draft a BID SUMMARY & PRICE ANALYSIS for a fictional fixed-price inspection subcontract. Two bidders quoted $142,000 and $151,000 for a six-month scope. The lower quote excludes travel, estimated separately at $14,000; the higher quote includes travel. The team proposes the $151,000 offer. Compare the known prices, flag the travel uncertainty, and include an element findings table.
entries.expected_result: A bid summary and element findings table with a supported price conclusion or stated gaps.

entries.title: Software/SaaS Negotiation Strategy
entries.description: Build discovery questions and negotiation plans for SaaS buys under the Simplified Acquisition Threshold.
entries.readme_prompt: Help me prepare questions and negotiation points for this SaaS renewal.
entries.starter_prompt: Prepare a negotiation strategy for a fictional federal SaaS renewal below the Simplified Acquisition Threshold. We have 40 seats at $18 per seat per month, but only 24 users log in weekly. The vendor proposes $22 per seat per month next year with annual prepayment. Give me internal questions, vendor questions, and options for seat mix, price lock, and payment terms.
entries.expected_result: A set of internal discovery questions, vendor questions, and negotiation options.

entries.title: GFP Receipt Discrepancy Correspondence
entries.description: Draft and review GFP receipt documentation requests, shipment discrepancy notices, and accountable-contract clarification requests.
entries.readme_prompt: Draft a notice about GFP received without complete shipment records.
entries.starter_prompt: Draft a concise receipt discrepancy email for this fictional shipment: five Government-furnished tablets arrived, the packing list names only four serial numbers, and the shipment label says Contract B while the advance notice says Contract A. Request corrected records and written clarification of the accountable contract without assuming which document is right.
entries.expected_result: A notice that identifies the shipment mismatch and requests the missing records.

entries.title: Government Property Contract Transfer Guide
entries.description: Explain GFP transfers, CAP delivery, cross-contract use, and physical movement; prepare or review a proposed transaction.
entries.readme_prompt: Explain what approvals and records this cross-contract property transfer needs.
entries.starter_prompt: Our fictional team wants to use a Government-owned test unit accountable to Contract A on Contract B next month. It will stay in the same lab, and no approval or contract modification is on file. Explain why physical location does not settle accountability, what authorization and record changes need confirmation, and who must decide before use.
entries.expected_result: A scenario checklist that separates proposed movement from authorized contract transfer.

entries.title: Government Property LTDD Relief Letter Generator
entries.description: Draft and review LTDD relief packages, separating verified facts from assumptions and evidence gaps.
entries.readme_prompt: Review this lost-property report for missing evidence before drafting a relief request.
entries.starter_prompt: Review this fictional LTDD case before drafting a relief letter. A Government-furnished laptop on Contract A was last inventoried March 15, its custodian changed April 2, and it was reported missing May 10. We have the inventory signoff but no transfer acknowledgment or search record. Separate known facts from assumptions, identify the most important evidence gaps, and outline what can be said now.
entries.expected_result: An evidence-gap review and draft structure that distinguishes known facts from assumptions.

entries.title: Government Property Written Direction Request
entries.description: Draft and review requests for written Government direction on proposed property actions, conflicting instructions, and unresolved next steps.
entries.readme_prompt: Draft a request for written direction about property left after contract closeout.
entries.starter_prompt: Draft a short request for written direction in this fictional situation: Contract A ended June 30, but three Government-furnished calibration units remain on site. The property team has no disposition instructions and proposes moving them to Contract B. Ask the Contracting Officer for the authorized next step without implying the transfer is approved.
entries.expected_result: A focused request stating the property status and the specific decision needed.

entries.title: Behind the Buy: The Butterfly Effect

entries.title: Behind the Buy: The True Cost of a Supplier

entries.title: Behind the Buy: The Competition Question
